public.prompt: A page places deferred `config.js`, then inline `startApp()`, then deferred `app.js` in `<head>`. In production `startApp()` runs before its dependencies. All three steps must execute `config` → `app` → `startApp` after parsing without blocking it. What is the smallest correct change?

options.label: Add `defer` to the inline bootstrap tag and leave it between the two deferred external scripts.
Move `startApp()` into `bootstrap.js`, then defer config, app, and bootstrap in dependency order.
Make all three scripts external and `async`, keeping dependency order only in the markup.

answerProof.summary: Defer affects classic external scripts, not inline code. Moving the bootstrap into an external script lets all three downloads avoid parser blocking while deferred execution preserves document order after parsing.
decisiveConstraints: Parsing must continue during every script download.
Config, app, and bootstrap must execute in that order.
Bootstrap must not run until the body has been parsed.

claims.statement: Defer has no effect on inline scripts; deferred classic external scripts execute after parsing in document order, while async scripts have no order guarantee.

optionRationales.explanation: The external files are deferred, but the inline call still executes immediately during head parsing before either deferred dependency.
optionRationales.plausibility: The inline call appears between the same tags and can look like part of their deferred sequence.
optionRationales.falsifyingConstraint: The bootstrap itself must execute after both dependencies and parsed body markup.

optionRationales.explanation: Making the bootstrap external lets defer govern every step, preserving non-blocking downloads, post-parse execution, and document order.
Async avoids parser blocking but executes each file when it becomes available, so document order cannot enforce the dependency chain.
optionRationales.plausibility: All three scripts are external and their source order visually expresses the intended dependency sequence.
optionRationales.falsifyingConstraint: Execution must remain config then app then bootstrap regardless of download completion order.
